GIMP cannot convert PNG to SVG format. GIMP is a raster graphics editor that works with pixel-based images, while SVG is a vector format. After checking all available export formats in GIMP's 'Select File Type' dialog, SVG/Scalable Vector Graphics is not among the supported export options. GIMP can import SVG files (converting them to raster), but it cannot export to vector formats.

To convert /home/user/logo.png to SVG format, you would need to use a vector graphics editor like Inkscape, which has built-in bitmap-to-vector conversion capabilities. You can use Inkscape's 'Trace Bitmap' feature to convert your PNG to SVG.
